Valve provides those services and that tool under its own terms; we do not control them, and they may change or stop working at any time. We are not responsible for their availability, behaviour or content, or for any action Valve takes on your account.

Wallpapers you download or import are created by third parties. OWE does not host, redistribute, review or endorse them, and claims no rights in them. Web wallpapers and scene scripts run code written by their creators, and web wallpapers may load content from the internet. Treat wallpapers like any software you install: only use content from creators you trust. We are not responsible for what third-party content does or shows.

5.3 GitHub

The app fetches update information and downloads from GitHub, which provides its services under its own terms.

Links in the app open in your browser. Third-party sites are governed by their own terms and policies.
